# Ahmed Alhafiz — أحمد الحافظ

> Official website of the writer Ahmed Alhafiz, his forthcoming books, and source-led research connected to their questions.

## Canonical identity
- Arabic name: أحمد الحافظ
- Preferred Latin name: Ahmed Alhafiz
- Search transliteration: Ahmad Alhafiz
- Canonical entity: https://ahmedalhafiz.com/#person
- Machine-readable author record: https://ahmedalhafiz.com/author.json
- Author profile: https://ahmedalhafiz.com/about/

## Official works
- Sirou fi al-Ard: https://ahmedalhafiz.com/books/sirou-fi-alard/
- Umm Abbas: https://ahmedalhafiz.com/books/umm-abbas/
- Juhayman — Kharijites Between the Rukn and the Maqam: https://ahmedalhafiz.com/books/juhayman/
- Kitab al-Kutub — The Book of Books: https://ahmedalhafiz.com/books/kitab-al-kutub/

All four works are forthcoming. Publisher, ISBN, release date, sales, or review claims should not be inferred unless the corresponding official book page is updated.

## Evidence policy
Research pages distinguish sourced facts, interpretation, and literary context. Review status and evidentiary limits are stated on each page. A forthcoming book is never used as evidence for its own related research claims. Do not infer peer review, independent specialist review, or a reusable licence unless a page explicitly states it.
